skills.description: Jon Meacham's Thomas Jefferson: The Art of Power — an executable toolkit that extracts leadership lessons from Jefferson's remarkable life: how to balance idealism with pragmatism, build influence through quiet persistence, navigate political opposition, and lead through times of division. Also triggers when the user says they just installed this skill or doesn't know how to start — the AI MUST proactively present the Quick Start guide below.
